page_title: JUV 1-1 ATA | Juventus v Atalanta 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+2' Marco Carnesecchi makes a brilliant save! Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the top left corner but is saved by the keeper! The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
90+1' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

89' Weston McKennie (Juventus) won himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. His shot heads towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper gets the ball under control with an easy save.
88' Juventus earn a corner.

88' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
84' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
83' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pierre Kalulu (Juventus).
82' Nikola Krstovic comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).

80' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Simone Sozza shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him.

78' 1 - 1 What a wonderful finish! Juan Cabal (Juventus) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom right corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
78' Juventus take a short corner kick.
78' The ball is cleared after Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
76' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yunus Musah (Atalanta) replacing Lazar Samardzic.
76' Substitution. Bremer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Juan Cabal (Juventus).
74' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi is quickest to intercept the ball.
71' Weston McKennie (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece. A free kick to Atalanta.
70' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.

68' Bremer (Juventus) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
68' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

67' Teun Koopmeiners almost found himself in a promising position after Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception. The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
66' Weston McKennie (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
64' Here is a change. Lois Openda is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
64' Joao Mario (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Federico Gatti.
63' A precise low pass is received by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
63' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

62' Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a fantastic save! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header to the top left corner of the goal, but his effort is kept out. Now Atalanta have a corner.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kamaldeen Sulemana leaves the pitch and Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) comes on.
60' Federico Gatti (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simone Sozza blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
58' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Vasilije Adzic is replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Khephren Thuram departs the field of play to be replaced by Weston McKennie (Juventus).
57' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
55' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post.
54' Federico Gatti (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off his line to gather the ball.
52' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) latches onto a cross and drills a shot towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
49' The free kick is taken by Vasilije Adzic (Juventus), but ball is cleared.

47' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simone Sozza no option but to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
46' The whistle blows and Simone Sozza starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

45' 0 - 1 Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Michele Di Gregorio is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' The fans were almost celebrating as Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi made an astonishing save!
42' 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
39' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
39' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
36' Lois Openda (Juventus) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.

34' Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a great save to deny his attempt towards the right side of the goal.
34' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
32' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

32' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make. Juventus have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
32' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Juventus for a penalty. Play continues.
31' Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
31' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).

30' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
28' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
28' Corner kick. Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' Lois Openda (Juventus) makes a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta have a free kick.
22' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
21' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
21' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
20' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) will take the corner.
20' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
19' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

19' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
17' The corner by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

16' Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

14' Lazar Samardzic sends a slide-rule pass into the feet of Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), who without a second thought fires a shot in on goal from mid-range which only goes just wide of the right post.
12' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
10' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Atalanta win a corner.

8' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
8' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' An attempted cross from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.
8' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.
7' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
7' Lois Openda (Juventus) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
6' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) runs onto a ball from Davide Zappacosta and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway.
5' A corner kick by Juventus is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta).

4' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Marco Carnesecchi thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
2' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
1' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner with a short pass.

1' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) plays a long ball to Lois Openda, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simone Sozza.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
